scope: Protected customer data access and associated App Store review prerequisites

current_functionality.description: Account owners connect stores with OAuth, select order/customer event subscriptions and view an encrypted, minimized event inbox. The API schedules legacy scrubbing, expiry and erasure work. Owners can download all pages of matching customer data and explicitly confirm secure delivery to the merchant. Data access is audited. Merchants can now configure Shopify order events to queue approved utility WhatsApp templates to consenting customers, using the existing WhatsApp sender and an encrypted durable outbox.
not_implemented: Automatic Shopify campaign creation or chatbot flow execution
Automatic delivery of customer exports to the merchant (the owner delivers them manually)
Merchant storefront/theme changes to collect and persist the order-message consent attribute; this repository contains the backend and merchant settings only.

protected_customer_data.reason: Our app receives merchant-selected Shopify order and customer events to display store updates and optionally send customer-consented WhatsApp order notifications. Order/customer identifiers, order status, timestamps and selected order fields associate each event with the correct store and render the merchant-selected approved utility template. The customer default or billing phone is used only for configured order-message rules. Inbox events are minimized and encrypted; message recipients and selected fields are stored in an encrypted queue, with scoped access, retention and customer erasure controls.
protected_customer_data.use_only_if: The Shopify listing describes this implemented event-inbox functionality. Confirm the remaining hosting, dashboard and operational requirements before certifying compliance.

phone.reason: To send merchant-configured WhatsApp order confirmations, payment updates, cancellations and order-change notifications to customers who have agreed to receive them. The customer default or billing phone number identifies the message recipient.

protected_customer_fields.qualification: Phone now has an implemented purpose. Name, Email and Address are not required by the supported order-message mappings. Sending requires merchant configuration, an approved utility template, explicit order consent, an available international phone and no existing opt-out. Public Phone access approval and a live store send remain unverified. Queued phone data is encrypted; sent content also enters linked WhatsApp history, which follows Shopify job erasure and retention.
